name: Verify Claims Against Output
summary: Re-run declared checks and compare every completion claim against fresh command output before accepting it.
description: Invoked as a slash command, executes the verification commands a change declares, hashes their output, and emits a verification report that separates verified claims from unverified ones. Runs only on a clean worktree so results attribute to committed state.
refuses: It does not approve, merge, or sign off on a change; it only reports what output proves.
It does not rerun checks with flags, environment, or inputs the user did not declare.
It does not start on a dirty worktree, because results would not attribute to a known state.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate the declared preconditions deterministically before the workflow may begin.

produces: a verification report whose every claim cites the fresh command output hash that proves or refutes it
requires: a clean git worktree so results attribute to committed state

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Restrict verification to a declared subset of checks.
